object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Delete an attribute that the rules file names in rule directives: once in a document made without attribute definitions, once in a document with a rule whose only directive names the attribute and a rule with a second directive. Expected: no rule directive names the attribute; the rule left with no directive is removed and the other rule keeps its other directive; the rules file is among the files written.
